name: 2010 Rust Rewrite Mashup
host: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 via IW4L
creator: chasmlol
notes: From-scratch Rust MW2 runtime with Skate 3 mode and a generated Minecraft world with blocks, mobs, inventory, mining and placement. v0.4.0 improved Minecraft-world frame pacing, made block edges grindable while skating, and fixed several gameplay/stability issues.

name: SkyCraft
host: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition
creator: chasmlol
notes: SKSE plugin and Fabric mod communicate through shared memory; Minecraft runs game logic while Skyrim renders the world.

name: Minecraft Crossover Bridge
host: Monster Hunter: World / Elden Ring via CrossOver on Apple Silicon macOS
creator: justbustin
notes: Bridges native macOS Minecraft into Windows games running under CrossOver via shared memory. Minecraft blocks, mobs and the player hand are composited into the host frame with depth/lighting; host terrain becomes Minecraft collision and damage is bridged both ways.

name: HytaleDoom
creator: tr7zw
notes: Java DOOM implementation rendered as raw pixel data inside a Hytale mod.

name: DoomMaps
creator: ssquadteam (Sadat Sahib / iamcxv7)
notes: Hytale plugin that renders DOOM frames to an in-game world-map display and maps player position/input into DOOM. Requires a user-supplied DOOM shareware WAD.

name: HyCraft
creator: EdwardBelt
notes: Protocol bridge that lets unmodified Minecraft Java clients join Hytale servers, translating packets and synchronising chunks, entities, interactions/combat and inventory.

name: UltraDoom / UltrakillDoom
creator: Squaresweets
notes: BepInEx plugin that runs playable DOOM on ULTRAKILL shop terminals. Uses a user-supplied legitimate/shareware DOOM WAD and builds on DoomInUnityInspector/Managed Doom lineage.

name: HellGate: Doom Portal
creator: fate_worshipper
notes: Fabric mod that opens a playable DOOM II experience through an in-world portal/altar, with DOOM progress persisted between sessions.

name: NucleDoom
creator: Patbox
notes: Server-side Fabric mod that runs DOOM inside Minecraft with sound support; shareware DOOM and Freedoom are supported by the project.

name: Wasmcraft game demos
creator: SuperTails
notes: WebAssembly-to-Minecraft datapack compiler demonstrated running multiple games and emulators inside vanilla Minecraft, including DOOM, Celeste Classic and an NES emulator running Super Mario Bros.

name: Dead by Daylight Add-On (Zero Squad)
creator: Zero Squad / MidoriyaMC
notes: Bedrock add-on recreating Dead by Daylight systems including generators and skill checks, pallets/vaulting, health states, hooks, lockers, Trapper bear traps, terror radius, carrying/wiggle mechanics and custom UI using Minecraft Script API.

name: Arcade Mod Reloaded
creator: Bay4lly; original mod by SuperHB
notes: Forge port/continuation of the older Arcade Mod with six playable arcade-game recreations inside Minecraft.

name: Halocraft
host: Halo 3 / Halo: The Master Chief Collection
creator: InfernoPlus
notes: Four destructible Minecraft-style multiplayer maps implemented in Halo 3.

name: Dark Souls: Remastest / Remastester
host: Dark Souls: Prepare to Die Edition
creator: InfernoPlus and collaborators
notes: Large multiplayer overhaul with Halo maps, weapons and other cross-game systems.

name: Ocarina of Time in Minecraft
guest: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
creator: Rivero
notes: Seven-year solo recreation intended to be playable from start to finish, including bosses, quests, items and story.

name: Pokémon Red in Minecraft
creator: MrSquishyYT / Mr. Squishy
notes: Complete playable recreation of Pokémon Red in vanilla Minecraft using command blocks and a resource pack, including the original progression and many game systems.

name: Minecraft voxel engine inside Super Mario 64
creator: Arthurtilly
notes: Custom voxel engine developed inside the SM64 engine; demonstrated running on original N64 hardware.

name: Morrowind in Elden Ring
creator: InfernoPlus and collaborators
notes: Large-scale WIP recreation of Morrowind in Elden Ring. A May 2026 creator update showed functional combat, spells and gear and described the project as fairly playable, but no public build has been located.

name: Minecraft Classic 0.30 inside Hytale
creator: Sadat Sahib / iamcxv7 / SSquadTeam
notes: Primary creator footage shows Minecraft Classic rendered through Hytale's world-map display using pixel-data manipulation/software rendering. No public build located.

name: Minecraft in Elden Ring
creator: TobynJacobs
notes: Primary creator footage exists, but no public repository/download was located; broader implementation claims remain externally unreproducible.

name: Minecraft in GTA V
notes: Viral footage/discussion; no matching public source or release verified.

name: Minecraft in Cyberpunk 2077
notes: No matching public source/release verified as of 2026-10-01.

name: Earlier viral Minecraft in Skyrim footage
notes: Earlier viral Minecraft-in-Skyrim footage was not independently sourced. Do not conflate it with SkyCraft, which is a separate public project.

name: Portal Zombies
host: Call of Duty: Black Ops III Zombies
creator: xdferpc
notes: Portal-themed Zombies map using Portal textures, models and teleporters; not a full Portal systems recreation.

name: Project Inception
creator: Arc-blroth
notes: Fabric mod that runs a fully featured second Minecraft instance on an in-world display and forwards player input to the inner game using a second process and memory-mapped IPC.

name: Latte Doom
creator: blackwithersteve
notes: DOOM source port for Minecraft. The vendored Mocha Doom engine runs inside Minecraft's JVM and owns the simulation while Minecraft renders it. Requires the user's own copy of DOOM. The linked source repository was unavailable during verification, so this entry is not marked source-available.

name: hytale2mc
creator: alskea
notes: Framework for cross-platform minigames shared between Minecraft and Hytale. It uses a custom ECS, Minestom, Hytale server plugins and NATS to synchronize game state. The project site advertises a live public server at play.hytale2mc.com.

name: CrossplayProject — Minecraft ↔ Roblox
host: Linked Minecraft server and Roblox experience
creator: Atmerek and contributors
notes: Archived but downloadable crossplay project that synchronizes blocks, players, mobs, time/weather, chat, skins and build/break interactions between Minecraft and Roblox via a Minecraft plugin HTTP API and Roblox scripts/models.

name: Minecraft ↔ Hytale crossplay (SSquadTeam)
host: Hytale server with an embedded Minecraft server
creator: Sadat Sahib / iamcxv7 / SSquadTeam
notes: Creator footage demonstrates Minecraft and Hytale clients sharing a Hytale-hosted world with synchronized players, block placement, time and chat. The creator describes a Minecraft server running inside Hytale's JVM with packet translation and shared world coordinates. No public source repository or build located.

name: Retro Handheld Emulator 1x1 scale
creator: JuanNasc
notes: Paid Hytale resource implementing a fully functional Game Boy emulator in-world at true 1:1 scale. Frames are computed and rendered live as 23,040 blocks, controls are mapped to in-game blocks, and the creator says no external tools are used.

name: talemonpokemon
creator: talemon
notes: Hytale mod recreating a substantial Pokémon adventure loop: starter selection, biome-based Pokémon spawning, levels/stats/types/abilities/moves, turn-based battles, capture, party/PC management, experience, evolution and Apricorn/Poké Ball progression.

name: PokeWorlds Online
creator: PokeWorlds Online
notes: Work-in-progress Hytale mod/server recreating classic top-down Pokémon. Creator footage shows a 2D world, party and inventory UI, trainer battles and turn-based combat. The creator says it partially uses RPG Maker XP Pokémon Essentials. No public playable release located.

name: ccboy — Game Boy in Minecraft
guest: Game Boy / Game Boy Color software
host: Minecraft: Java Edition with ComputerCraft / CC:Tweaked
creator: amatheo
notes: Streams Game Boy frames from an external headless PyBoy emulator over WebSocket to a ComputerCraft monitor and sends Minecraft-side controls back. Tracked as adjacent because the emulator itself runs outside Minecraft.

name: GeometryTale
creator: risp
notes: Downloadable Hytale world recreating Geometry Dash-style 2D side-scrolling levels. Kept adjacent because it is a contained custom-world/minigame recreation rather than a broad runtime or systems port.

name: Minecraft, but It's Crash Bandicoot (Remake)
creator: OfficialTCK
notes: Two Crash Bandicoot levels recreated as a vanilla Minecraft world with custom gameplay mechanics and resource packs. Kept adjacent because it is a limited custom-world recreation rather than a full game/runtime port.
